references.text: Joshua selects thirty thousand men and gives them orders to lie in ambush behind the city. This is the earlier instruction that verse 12 carries out with a smaller force of five thousand men.
The first time Joshua sent men against Ai, he sent them from Jericho toward Bethel. The same geographical area is mentioned here with Bethel and Ai.
Joshua sends them off to the ambush, and they lie in wait between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai. This verse describes the location of the ambush that verse 12 elaborates on.
Bethel and Ai are mentioned together again. All the men went out to pursue Israel, leaving the city open. The ambush from verse 12 took advantage of this situation.
Judges describes a similar ambush tactic against Gibeah, where Israel lay in wait around the city.
